errors.text_span: The two pie charts compare the distribution of categories between "AttentionInfluence" and "FineWeb-Edu Classifier".
errors.evidence: The charts are not simple pie charts; they are sunburst charts with two hierarchical levels (an inner and an outer ring of categories).
The "AttentionInfluence" chart has 21 slices in total (5 in the inner ring and 16 in the outer ring), not 16.
The value for "Education" is 25, not 25%. The numbers in the charts are absolute counts, not percentages. This error is repeated for all values mentioned.
The slice for "Education" is colored teal/green, not blue.
The slice for "Health & Medicine" is colored red/coral, not blue.
The slice for "Tech & Engineer" is colored brown/terracotta, not red.

errors.text_span: with the remaining categories ranging from approximately 1-7%
errors.evidence: The remaining categories in the "AttentionInfluence" chart have values ranging from 1 up to 15 (e.g., Science is 15), not 1-7. The unit is also not a percentage.

errors.text_span: The "FineWeb-Edu Classifier" chart also has 16 slices
errors.evidence: The "FineWeb-Edu Classifier" chart has 20 slices in total (4 in the inner ring and 16 in the outer ring), not 16.
The slice for "Education" in the second chart is colored teal/green, not blue.
The slice for "Health & Medicine" in the second chart is colored red/coral, not blue.
The slice for "Science" in the second chart is colored red/coral, not blue.

errors.text_span: The slices in both charts are generally arranged in a clockwise order by size, with the largest slices first.
errors.evidence: The slices are not arranged in descending order of size. For example, in the "AttentionInfluence" chart, the sequence of values for the outer ring slices starting from the top right is 15, 10, 11, 5, 6, 13, 15, 2, 7, 10, 6, 5, 3, 4, 2, 1, which is not sorted by size.
